response.sql: SELECT AVG(group_pressratio_avg) as overall_pressratio_avg, AVG(group_size_per_min_avg) as overall_size_per_min_avg FROM (SELECT scans.zoneref, sites.typesite, AVG(scans.pressratio) as group_pressratio_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND scans.spanmin > 0 THEN scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin ELSE NULL END) as group_size_per_min_avg FROM scans INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE scans.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND scans.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.typesite) grouped

assumptions.assumption: chronotag column stores values in a format that supports meaningful text comparison (e.g., ISO 8601 strings or timestamp type comparable lexicographically). The request explicitly specifies comparing 'as text'. If chronotag is stored as numeric Excel serial dates (as documented as a possibility), text comparison would not work correctly.
